name: bioparrot
description: BioParrot – academic-first bilingual translator for web pages, PDFs and Zotero

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dotfiles.mjs src public && node node_modules/wxt/bin/wxt.mjs build && node scripts/clean-dotfiles.mjs .output
scripts.build:firefox: node scripts/clean-dotfiles.mjs src public && node node_modules/wxt/bin/wxt.mjs build -b firefox && node scripts/clean-dotfiles.mjs .output
scripts.zip: node scripts/clean-dotfiles.mjs src public && node node_modules/wxt/bin/wxt.mjs zip
scripts.zip:firefox: node scripts/clean-dotfiles.mjs src public && node node_modules/wxt/bin/wxt.mjs zip -b firefox
scripts.test: node scripts/clean-dotfiles.mjs tests && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:firefox && npm run build:zotero
